script.title: Cinderwing and the Last Ember
script.description: An obsidian dragon shelters its glowing egg beneath raised scalloped crimson wings. A sweeping neck, open fanged jaw, ivory horns, plated haunches and a hooked tail give the guardian a powerful silhouette.
